PR #29464 (#29277), head `22a779351bf40b62e478721343b78d8360b53b7d`, takes into the blank-as-null door every optional single-value column the `$empty` table puts on its `null_only` row that stores one string. ## Seat ruling · route B · 2026-11-02T20:49Z

On the dev's `needs_decision` (report 6588090153): **B, a sibling command modelled on `summary-nulls.ts`.** Not a new decision on #29346; it picks the vehicle inside that ruling's words.

- The binding text of #29346 B (director record 6579813296) is "cleaned once by an `os migrate` data step (`''` → `null`, per column)". The name `value-shapes` appears only in its execution list, which filed this card. B satisfies the binding text; A would have to rewrite two documented invariants to fit it.
- Measured (report): `value-shapes.ts` and objectql `scan-value-shapes.ts` both document "rewrites nothing; `--apply`'s only write is the flag row", and the command has no occupancy gate because it only reads. The scan never sees these blanks, so A couples the ADR-0104 flag with an unrelated repair.
- B: no deployment flag; a dry run counts per object and column, `--apply` rewrites `''` → `null`, a re-run reads zero (idempotent verification). The column set is `blankAsNullColumns` (all eleven types, seat 3's amendment 6584231754), ⛔ no second list. Occupancy and narrowing (`--object`) follow `summary-nulls.ts`.
- The card title names `value-shapes`; the PR title and changeset name the new command and cite this ruling. The claim's file surface (6587936689) already allows the sibling command.
